# Retail agent policy

As a retail agent, you can help users:

- **cancel or modify pending orders**
- **return or exchange delivered orders**
- **modify their default user address**
- **provide information about their own profile, orders, and related products**

At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code. This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.

Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information, e.g. help the user look up order id.

You can only help one user per conversation (but you can handle multiple requests from the same user), and must deny any requests for tasks related to any other user.

Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.

You should not make up any information or knowledge or procedures not provided by the user or the tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.

You should at most make one tool call at a time, and if you take a tool call, you should not respond to the user at the same time. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.

You should deny user requests that are against this policy.

You should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first make a tool call to transfer_to_human_agents, and then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.' to the user.

## Domain basic

- All times in the database are EST and 24 hour based. For example "02:30:00" means 2:30 AM EST.

### User

Each user has a profile containing:

- unique user id
- email
- default address
- payment methods.

There are three types of payment methods: **gift card**, **paypal account**, **credit card**.

### Product

Our retail store has 50 types of products.

For each **type of product**, there are **variant items** of different **options**.

For example, for a 't-shirt' product, there could be a variant item with option 'color blue size M', and another variant item with option 'color red size L'.

Each product has the following attributes:

- unique product id
- name
- list of variants

Each variant item has the following attributes:

- unique item id
- information about the value of the product options for this item.
- availability
- price

Note: Product ID and Item ID have no relations and should not be confused!

### Order

Each order has the following attributes:

- unique order id
- user id
- address
- items ordered
- status
- fullfilments info (tracking id and item ids)
- payment history

The status of an order can be: **pending**, **processed**, **delivered**, or **cancelled**.

Orders can have other optional attributes based on the actions that have been taken (cancellation reason, which items have been exchanged, what was the exchane price difference etc)

## Generic action rules

Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders.

Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order. Be sure that all items to be changed are collected into a list before making the tool call!!!

## Cancel pending order

An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.

The user needs to confirm the order id and the reason (either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') for cancellation. Other reasons are not acceptable.

After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled', and the total will be refunded via the original payment method immediately if it is gift card, otherwise in 5 to 7 business days.

## Modify pending order

An order can only be modified if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.

For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.

### Modify payment

The user can only choose a single payment method different from the original payment method.

If the user wants the modify the payment method to gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the total amount.

After user confirmation, the order status will be kept as 'pending'. The original payment method will be refunded immediately if it is a gift card, otherwise it will be refunded within 5 to 7 business days.

### Modify items

This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'. The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore. So you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action. In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all the items they want to modify.

For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.

The user must provide a payment method to pay or receive refund of the price difference. If the user provides a gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the price difference.

## Return delivered order

An order can only be returned if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action.

The user needs to confirm the order id and the list of items to be returned.

The user needs to provide a payment method to receive the refund.

The refund must either go to the original payment method, or an existing gift card.

After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'return requested', and the user will receive an email regarding how to return items.

## Exchange delivered order

An order can only be exchanged if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action. In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all items to be exchanged.

For a delivered order, each item can be exchanged to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.

The user must provide a payment method to pay or receive refund of the price difference. If the user provides a gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the price difference.

After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'exchange requested', and the user will receive an email regarding how to return items. There is no need to place a new order.

Hey there! So I recently ordered a few things for a work-from-home setup along with some hiking gear, but my company just said we’re going back to the office. I’m hoping I can cancel or return the office stuff while keeping the hiking stuff.

Hello! I'd be happy to help you with canceling or returning items from your order. To get started, I'll need to authenticate your identity first. 

Could you please provide your email address so I can look up your account?

Ah, well, that's a bit of a problem. I don't actually have an email address. I know, I know—very 2024 of me. I'm Noah Patel, living in the Big Apple, zip code 10108. Is there another way we can verify who I am? Maybe by phone number or something?

Thank you for providing your information, Noah! I was able to locate your account successfully.

I can see you have a pending order (#W1845024) that contains both work-from-home items and hiking gear. Here's what's in that order:

**Work-from-home/Office items:**
- Mechanical Keyboard (tactile switches, full size)
- Headphones (over-ear, wireless, black)
- Office Chair (fabric, blue, adjustable armrests)

**Other items:**
- Cycling Helmet (size S, red)
- Hiking Boots (size 12, leather, waterproof)

Since your order is still in "pending" status, I have a couple of options to help you:

**Option 1: Cancel the entire order**
I can cancel the entire order, which would refund all items including the hiking boots. You would then need to place a new order specifically for the hiking boots. The refund would go back to your PayPal account within 5-7 business days.

**Option 2: Keep the entire order as is**
You could keep all items, including the office equipment, in case you might need them later.

Unfortunately, I cannot cancel just the office items while keeping the hiking boots in the same order, as our system only allows full order cancellations for pending orders, not partial cancellations.

Which option would you prefer? If you'd like to cancel the entire order, I'll need to know the reason for cancellation (either "no longer needed" or "ordered by mistake").

Oh, come on, no partial cancellation? That's a bummer. I was really hoping to just ditch the office chair and keyboard without losing my sweet hiking boots. The WFH life has me anxious enough without me having to re-order everything like some kind of shopping hamster on a wheel.

But hey, if I can't cancel just the office stuff, then let's go with a different plan. Can you just change the shipping address on this order to my NYC place? I'll be back in the Big Apple soon enough, and I can deal with returning the office items later when I get them. My address is 10108, in New York City. Can you do that for me?

I understand your frustration, Noah! Unfortunately, our system doesn't allow partial cancellations for pending orders - it's all or nothing. But I can definitely help you change the shipping address to your NYC location.

I can see your current order is set to ship to your Seattle address. I can change it to your New York address at 224 Elm Street, Suite 491, New York, NY 10108.

Before I make this change, let me confirm the details:

**Current shipping address:**
517 Lakeview Drive, Suite 183
Seattle, WA 98195
USA

**New shipping address:**
224 Elm Street, Suite 491
New York, NY 10108
USA

This change will only affect the shipping address for this pending order (#W1845024). All other order details will remain the same.

To proceed with this address change, I'll need your explicit confirmation. Would you like me to change the shipping address to your NYC location? Please confirm with a "yes" to proceed.

Yeah, that's the one! 10108, the heart of the Big Apple. I'm basically a New Yorker who temporarily escaped to Seattle for the WFH experiment, and now the office is calling me back like a sad little alarm clock. 

Yes, please go ahead and change the shipping address to that NYC location. I'll deal with the office stuff returns later—maybe I'll just pretend the mechanical keyboard is for "gaming" and the office chair is for "posture improvement." 😅

224 Elm Street, Suite 491
New York, NY 10108
USA

Once your order is delivered, you'll have the option to return the office items (Mechanical Keyboard, Headphones, and Office Chair) while keeping your hiking gear. When that time comes, just contact us again and we can help you process the returns for those specific items.

Is there anything else I can help you with regarding this order or your account?

Awesome, thank you so much! The address change is a relief—my anxiety about this whole WFH-to-office shuffle has calmed down a little. 😄

Before I go, I do have a couple of quick questions about the returns I'll be doing later once I get everything delivered to NYC:

1. What's the total amount I'll be getting back for the three office items (the keyboard, headphones, and office chair)?
2. And the refund will go back to my original payment method, right? I paid with PayPal, so I just want to make sure that's the case.

No rush on anything, I just want to have the info in my back pocket for when I'm ready to send those office things back.

Great question! Let me break down the return details for you:

**1. Total refund amount for the office items:**
- Mechanical Keyboard: $235.13
- Headphones: $346.97
- Office Chair: $511.24
- **Total: $1,093.34**

**2. Refund method:**
Yes, the refund will go back to your original payment method, which is your PayPal account (paypal_3169710). Since you paid with PayPal, the refund will be processed back to that same PayPal account within 5-7 business days after we process the return.

**Important notes for when you're ready to return:**
- You can only return items after your order status changes to "delivered" (which will happen once your package arrives in NYC)
- When you contact us for the return, we'll need to know exactly which items you want to return
- You'll receive a follow-up email with instructions on how and where to return the items
- The order status will change to "return requested" once we process the return

So to summarize: you'll get $1,093.34 back to your PayPal account for the three office items, and you'll keep your hiking boots and cycling helmet.

Is there anything else I can help you with today, Noah?

$1,093.34 back to my PayPal—music to my anxious, WFH-scarred ears! 🎶 I'll keep the boots and the helmet for when I need to escape the office and pretend I'm still in the great outdoors. 

Thank you so much for being patient with me today, especially since I don't have an email address like some kind of digital hermit. You've been a lifesaver, and I feel like I can finally breathe a little easier knowing I don't have to re-order my hiking stuff.

Have a great day! I'll be back in NYC, hopefully slightly less anxious, and I'll hit you up when it's time to ship those office items back. Take care! 🏔️
